'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

****The [[United Nations]] declares the situation in [[North Gaza Governorate|northern]] [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] as "apocalyptic", with the entire [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] population there at "imminent risk of dying from [[disease]], [[famine]] and [[violence]]" due to [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] bombardments and [[Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|aid blockage]]. ***Arrests have been made over suspected leaks of classified documents, involving an official closely associated with Prime Minister [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/netanyahu-media-organizations-request-removal-of-gag-order-on-pmo-security-affair/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Puntland–Somaliland dispute]]
***[[Las Anod conflict (2023–present)|Las Anod conflict]]
****At least ten people, including four [[civilian]]s, are killed and fifteen others are injured in battles between [[Somaliland Armed Forces|Somaliland]] and [[Khatumo State]] forces in the [[Cayn]] and [[Togdheer]] regions. [https://horseedmedia.net/dagaalo-khasaare-dhaliyey-oo-ka-dhacay-waqooyiga-buuhoodle-394351 (Horseed Media)] [https://hiiraan.com/news/2024/Oct/wararka_maanta31-188287.htm (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[2024 Bolivian protest]]
**An "[[irregular armed group]]" captures a [[Armed Forces of Bolivia|Bolivian military]] base near [[Cochabamba]], [[Bolivia]], [[kidnap]]ping [[military personnel]] and seizing weapons from the base. [[President of Bolivia|Bolivian president]] [[Luis Arce]] says that the group are affiliated with former president [[Evo Morales]]. *[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**At least nine people are killed and 29 others are injured in a [[Improvised explosive device|bombing]] near a girls' school in [[Mastung District|Mastung]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]], targeting a [[Polio vaccine|polio vaccination]] drive. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/1/five-children-among-seven-killed-in-attack-on-pakistan-polio-vaccine-drive (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Israeli naval commandos launch a raid in northern [[Lebanon]]. Lebanese media says it was carried out in coordination with the [[German Navy]] to prevent the [[Lebanese Navy]] from interfering. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israeli-commandos-said-to-nab-top-hezbollah-naval-commander-in-north-lebanon-raid/ (''The Times of Israel'')] 

'''Business and economy'''

[https://www.cnbc.com/2024/11/02/china-eases-rules-for-foreign-investment-in-listed-companies.html (CNBC)]

**Fourteen people are killed and three others are injured when a canopy collapses at the [[Novi Sad railway station|railway station]] in [[Novi Sad]], [[Serbia]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/International/wireStory/8-killed-roof-collapse-serbian-railway-station-115393448 (ABC News)]
